_doc.about: nil: slow and warm, letterbox, warm grade, eased dissolves (the «بنت النيل» look, 2026-11-08). Replace every path with a real file; paths are relative to this spec's folder.
_doc.style: which engine draws the film: nil | beat | wall | medal | chapters | clean
_doc.name: file name of the final film (DIR/<name>.mp4); Arabic is fine
_doc.duration: film length in seconds; the render has exactly round(duration * fps) frames
_doc.watermark: persistent text bottom left (the owner's: © Mahmoud Elkosif)
_doc.credit: 1-2 lines shown on the end card (the owner's credit and follow line)
_doc.song: path = the song file; start = second of the song the film starts on; fade_in / fade_out in seconds; mixed to -14 LUFS into mix.m4a
_doc.leak: true adds the warm light-leak sweep to every dissolve (off: the owner removed sun / light-leak washes on 2026-11-01)
_doc.shots[].src: a video or a still image
_doc.shots[].start / end: where the shot sits in the film, seconds
_doc.shots[].focus: [x, y] fractions of the box: the point the 9:16 crop is centred on (a face); default [0.5, 0.42]
_doc.shots[].box: [x, y, w, h] in source pixels: the part of the picture that may be used (cuts burnt captions, logos)
_doc.shots[].zoom: 1 = the largest 9:16 crop inside the box; 1.3 = a closer punch
_doc.shots[].speed: 1 = real time; 0.5-0.8 = slow motion for key moments (setpts)
_doc.title: gold Ruqaa title over the opening shot, start..end seconds
_doc.lines: her words, revealed word by word (Tajawal 62 at y 1620); per line: font, size, gold, y
_doc.end: end card: at = when it starts, title = gold Ruqaa name; the credit follows 1 s later
